definitions.explanation: Fabric produced by weaving threads together on a loom. Refers to the product itself or the craft of weaving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{織物|おりもの}。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{織物|おりもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This region is known as a textile production area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な{織物|おりもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}えたい→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to pass down traditional weaving techniques to the next generation.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers broadly to any woven fabric, but often carries connotations of traditional or artisanal craftsmanship. Japan has many famous regional textiles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{絹|きぬ}→絹：01383_kinu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{織物|おりもの}: silk textile
- {織物|おりもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧: textile production area
- {織物|おりもの}⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧: textile factory
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧{織物|おりもの}: traditional textile

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has many renowned regional textiles, such as {西陣織|にしじんおり} from Kyoto and {大島紬|おおしまつむぎ} from Kagoshima, which are used for high-quality kimono fabric.
